question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing benchwarmer, and Eve is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left winger
(C) sweeper
(D) benchwarmer
(E) cheerleader
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: right back | left winger | sweeper | benchwarmer | cheerleader
1. Alice–Dave: benchwarmer | left winger | sweeper | right back | cheerleader
2. Alice–Dave: right back | left winger | sweeper | benchwarmer | cheerleader
3. Eve–Claire: right back | left winger | cheerleader | benchwarmer | sweeper
4. Dave–Claire: right back | left winger | benchwarmer | cheerleader | sweeper
5. Claire–Eve: right back | left winger | sweeper | cheerleader | benchwarmer
Bob is playing left winger, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
